class.name: SteamWebTicket
class.brief_description: Holds a revocable Steam Web API ticket.

method.name: bytes
method.description: Returns the opaque bytes while the issuing scope and ticket are active. Transfer them only to the trusted verifier. Keep them out of save data, replays, and logs.

method.name: close
method.description: Cancels this ticket and clears its stored bytes. Call on the main thread after the backend no longer needs the ticket. Repeated calls are safe.
